Noivern

Flying Dragon

Kalos · Generation 6

Noivern is a Flying/Dragon-type Sound Wave Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 85 kg. It evolves from Noibat. Its highest base stat is Speed (123), with a base stat total of 535.
